name: A4 reference
description: Concert A4 is zero transposition; play other keys to retune the oscillator bank.

name: A2 drone reference
description: Reference A2 (110 Hz) for a drone bank already tuned around A2.

name: C3 reference
description: C3 is unison; other keys transpose relative to that note.

name: Start a fifth up
description: Begin seven semitones above the base tuning until the first key; reset returns here.

name: Start an octave down
description: Begin twelve semitones below base tuning; live keys latch their own offset.
